```blitzbasic
FreeTimer:Void timer:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | In | Int32 | required | The timer handle. |

## Description

Deletes a timer you no longer need. Passing 0 does nothing.
